id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|41d5: "I'll help care for the girl you brought. Women's hands may be needed.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|41e9: "Yggdrasil returns to the center of the sky. What a wonderful miracle. Thank the Goddess...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|41f6: "...Speaking of miracles, the girl we cared for at the church woke up the other day. Good things come together.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|420a: "How strange. Lately I faintly hear someone's cry of sorrow...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4217: "This is... a girl's voice lamenting in the dim dark... I sense it faintly from north of the Viking hideout.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|422a: "Strangely, until recently I heard a sad girl's voice suffering in the dark from somewhere...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|423a: "But lately that voice no longer reaches me. If its owner was saved by someone, that's wonderful.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|425f: "Hmm, strange... The harbor pier was just repaired, yet it's awfully worn.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4279: "Hmm, strange... The harbor pier was just repaired, yet it's awfully worn.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4268: "I didn't cut corners, so can it wear this fast? It feels like months passed without my noticing.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4282: "I didn't cut corners, so can it wear this fast? It feels like months passed without my noticing.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4293: "That lady drinking with Charlotte lately is a real beauty.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|429a: "She seems fun. Let's invite her for a drink sometime.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42a8: "At Sniflheim's bay entrance and the road to Snaerfelt, huge golden icebergs appeared.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42b5: "I don't know if it's the Gold Plague's effect, but sea and land routes closed and this area became a land island.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42c3: "The port is deserted and we have no work. We just drink.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42d4: "I heard the gold monsters who attacked the town headed here too. I rushed over to check.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42e0: "...It seems the priest there was also attacked by monsters. He's quite shocked.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42eb: "The priest himself is unhurt, but his acquaintance with him was taken away, apparently.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|42fd: "The Vikings who docked at this town, I met many times while working at the port.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|430a: "Could they really be those gold monsters from before?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4311: "But if so, the monsters sailing and navigating well makes sense. ...Damn, my head is confused.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4320: "The golden icebergs vanished and the port is slowly regaining life. All right, let's get to work too!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4332: "A friend living in Gondolia escaped by ship. The town was attacked by a monster horde.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4350: "A friend living in Gondolia escaped by ship. The town was attacked by a monster horde.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|433f: "I only heard it, but it reminds me of the Dundrasil tragedy sixteen years ago... Smells fishy.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|435d: "I only heard it, but it reminds me of the Dundrasil tragedy sixteen years ago... Smells fishy.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4381: "Huh, what's going on? Yesterday many ships were docked, but there are far fewer.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|438c: "Can they decrease this much in one day? Strange things happen.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4397: "Next to Sniflheim live Vikings skilled in navigation. They aren't bad, but a bit rough.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43a4: "If you head to the Viking hideout, be careful.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43af: "Better not. That lady, Lizzlette, apparently uses very powerful ice spells.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43bc: "If you carelessly anger her, you may get frozen stiff.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43c8: "Sail from this town's port to a nearby cave: the Vikings who base themselves at Sniflheim have a hideout there.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43d6: "They used to show up in town, but lately I haven't seen them. It bothers me a bit.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43e7: "A Viking just came to this port for the first time in a while.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43ee: "...Yes, of course not as a monster, but in normal human form. Go to their hideout and you may meet them.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|43ff: "A merchant who came from another country to trade said a black sun appeared above Gallopolis or something...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|441d: "A merchant who came from another country to trade said a black sun appeared above Gallopolis or something...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|440e: "But there should have been only one sun in the sky from ages ago. I can hardly believe it...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|442c: "But there should have been only one sun in the sky from ages ago. I can hardly believe it...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4441: "I just arrived in Sniflheim to see Yggdrasil. Now I'll head to Zwaardsrust.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|444d: "It was a long voyage. I rocked on the waves so long I'm used to seasickness.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|445e: "I'm going to Zwaardsrust to see Yggdrasil, but the cold makes me hesitate.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|446b: "What, Zwaardsrust's location? It's southeast through the depths of Snaerfelt...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4478: "Monsters on the mountain are said to be very strong. If you go, better prepare your equipment.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4489: "Hey mister, listen! A giant dragon appeared deep in Snaerfelt near the frozen lake!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4497: "At the castle, Charlotte is seeking help from skilled folks like you against the dread dragon.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|44a8: "Hey mister, listen! I went to see the dread dragon near the frozen lake and it's gone!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|44b6: "Someone must have slain it. To defeat such a strong-looking monster, there are kind people out there.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|44dd: "Sniflheim has thriving magic research, including technology to imbue objects with magical power.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4508: "Sniflheim has thriving magic research, including technology to imbue objects with magical power.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|44e9: "The weapons and armor sold here are imbued with magic, and some produce special effects.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4514: "The weapons and armor sold here are imbued with magic, and some produce special effects.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|44f6: "Scary monsters lurk all over the snowfield. If you're heading there, prepare well.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4521: "Scary monsters lurk all over the snowfield. If you're heading there, prepare well.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4531: "Sniflheim leads all nations in research on magic and scholarship.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|454e: "Sniflheim leads all nations in research on magic and scholarship.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|453a: "...But against the Gold Plague, we're helpless. It's as if our country's pride were denied, which saddens and scares me.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|456b: "Having overcome this incident, Sniflheim will surely develop even further.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4585: "Having overcome this incident, Sniflheim will surely develop even further.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4576: "That's possible thanks to you defeating the plague and monsters. Thank you so much.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4591: "That's possible thanks to you defeating the plague and monsters. Thank you so much.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|45b2: "This bard seems to have hurt his throat. Until yesterday his voice was clear as glass, so I'm a bit worried.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|45c2: "Mmm, beautiful... The bard's voice seems to be back. I'd like to listen to this lovely voice forever.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|45d3: "Mmm, beautiful... The bard's voice seems to be back. I'd like to listen to this lovely voice forever.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|45e5: "That bard and dancer just met, yet they're in perfect sync.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|45f0: "If the two went around the world as a duo, they'd be quite famous.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|45fd: "That girl and I love songs. At times like this I wanted to hear a song to lift my mood, but it's hard.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|460c: "...About the Gold Plague? Sorry, I know nothing. I only pray that at least my daughter is saved.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|461e: "When the gold monsters attacked, we'd just gone home and luckily survived.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|462c: "At times like this I wanted my daughter to hear songs for a change, but that was a close call.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|463c: "Yes, yes, a lovely song. Thanks to you, this bard's cheerful voice is back.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|465e: "The bard's throat is bad. But that's fine, I'll wait. I'll keep waiting for his next song.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|466e: "Listening to the bard's songs, all kinds of scenes come to mind! I hope I can sing like that someday!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4681: "Listening to the bard's songs, all kinds of scenes come to mind! I hope I can sing like that someday!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4692: "The dancer's dance is amazing. How can she dance with such tempo? I wish I could dance like that.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|46a2: "Lately this bard only sings scary songs. But I believe he'll sing a fun, lovely song someday.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|46b3: "Thank you, big brothers. We can hear fun, lovely songs again!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|470c:
A horse led by a man
is frozen.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4713:
The horse gazes at the sea.
It seems calm in the cold sea breeze.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4724:
The horse stands calmly.
It seems to feel safe and calm in this small ranch.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|483b: "Ugh, so cold... Walking in the blizzard, I got separated from my comrades. I must rejoin them before meeting the witch...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|484f: "What's with this cold?! I followed Captain Hendrik back to town and the blizzard has grown fierce!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|485c: "And the captain's group had already sailed, leaving me behind... Insult to injury!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|486c: "Wow, that was a shock. The castle's ice suddenly melted. Did someone defeat the witch?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4877: "If so, someone defeated a witch even Captain Hendrik couldn't. What a person.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4886: "No sign of Captain Hendrik's group returning. To think I was really left behind...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4891: "Everyone forgot me when leaving. Isn't that awful? Too awful to even laugh about...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|48a4: "Lately monsters suddenly increased, so I'm cooperating with Sniflheim soldiers to slay them.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|48af: "I'm a Heliodor soldier, but as a person I can't ignore monsters disturbing public order.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|48db:
He breathes peacefully in his sleep.
He's unconscious, but clearly alive.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|50eb:
He breathes peacefully in his sleep.
He's unconscious, but clearly alive.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|48ea: "A treasure-hunting trip with Bro... Heh, until then I'll behave and wait obediently.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|50fb: "A treasure-hunting trip with Bro... Heh, until then I'll behave and wait obediently.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|48f7: "...So after your business, hurry back this time, dumb Bro. I won't have it unless I'm with you.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5107: "...So after your business, hurry back this time, dumb Bro. I won't have it unless I'm with you.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4904: "...Oh! Just so you know, if we find treasure, my share is bigger, of course. ...Hee hee.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5114: "...Oh! Just so you know, if we find treasure, my share is bigger, of course. ...Hee hee.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|491f: "I'm fine now. Well... you saved me. Thanks. But more than that...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|512f: "I'm fine now. Well... you saved me. Thanks. But more than that...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4929: "It seems my necklace lost its power to turn things gold just now.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5139: "It seems my necklace lost its power to turn things gold just now.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4933: "I thought I'd get filthy rich, but thanks to dumb Bro and his friends, I'm still poor...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5144: "I thought I'd get filthy rich, but thanks to dumb Bro and his friends, I'm still poor...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4947: "When your adventure with your friends ends, come on a treasure hunt with me! That's how you atone, Bro.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5158: "When your adventure with your friends ends, come on a treasure hunt with me! That's how you atone, Bro.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4958: "...Until then, I'll lend my necklace to you. So absolutely come back to return it.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5168: "...Until then, I'll lend my necklace to you. So absolutely come back to return it.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|496f: "I'm only lending the necklace! So don't lose to monsters, so you can return it to me.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5180: "I'm only lending the necklace! So don't lose to monsters, so you can return it to me.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|497a: "No matter what treasure I get, I don't want it unless Bro's with me...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|518a: "No matter what treasure I get, I don't want it unless Bro's with me...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4984: "...Oh! Just so you know, if we find treasure, my share is bigger, of course. ...Hee hee.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5194: "...Oh! Just so you know, if we find treasure, my share is bigger, of course. ...Hee hee.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|499f: "A guest at this hideout is rare. Do you have business with my Vikings?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|49a9: "...Mind you, we've done nothing wrong. I care only for adventure, treasure, and good rum.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|49b5: "So I'm ignorant of everything else, and have no idea what's going on in the world lately. Gahaha!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|49c5: "Am I imagining it? I feel like I fought you somewhere... like you helped me a lot...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|49ce: "Eh, small details don't matter. Since you came to our hideout, make yourself at home. Gahaha!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|49e4: "Yo-ho! Crossing the North Sea's rough waves, you folks have guts.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|49ed: "I wish our young ones were like that. The Viking life isn't easy; some of them run away.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|49ff: "I dreamed I was bossed around by a kid I used to boss around. Woke up feeling awful.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4a0b: "...Truth is, reversing roles made me feel sorry. If I get the chance, I'll apologize.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4a23: "The gold and silver treasures gathered here are what we Vikings collected around the world.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4a2e: "Hehe, not mine, but just looking makes me grin. Treasure's shine is the best.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4a3d: "Eeek! I don't know why, but gold is scary!!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4a43: "I loved gold and silver treasure above all, yet now it scares me most. I don't get it at all!

tm.「……どうやら そこの神父さんも\n 魔物どもに 襲われたようでな。\n ずいぶ: "...It seems the priest there was also attacked by monsters. He's quite shocked.
tm.「神父さん自身は ことなきを得たそうだが\n 一緒にいた 彼の知り合いが\n 連: "The priest himself is unhurt, but his acquaintance with him was taken away, apparently.
tm.「この町に寄港していた バイキングたちなら\n オレも 港で仕事をしていた時に\: "The Vikings who docked at this town, I met many times while working at the port.
tm.「あいつらが さっきの黄金の魔物だなんて\n そんなことが ありうるのか？: "Could they really be those gold monsters from before?
tm.「だが それなら魔物どもが船に乗って\n 航海にたけていたのも うなずけるか。\: "But if so, the monsters sailing and navigating well makes sense. ...Damn, my head is confused.

tm.「ダーハルーネに住んでた友達が\n 船に乗って 逃げてきたんだ。\n 町が 魔物: "A friend living in Gondolia escaped by ship. The town was attacked by a monster horde.
tm.「オレは 話を聞いただけだが まるで\n １６年前の ユグノアの悲劇を思わせるぜ: "I only heard it, but it reminds me of the Dundrasil tragedy sixteen years ago... Smells fishy.

tm.「たった１日で こんなに減るもんかなあ。\n おかしなことも あるもんだぜ。: "Can they decrease this much in one day? Strange things happen.

tm.「もし バイキングのアジトに向かうのなら\n 用心したほうがいいぜ。: "If you head to the Viking hideout, be careful.

tm.「下手に ちょっかいをかけて 怒らせると\n カッチコッチに 凍らされるかもしれ: "If you carelessly anger her, you may get frozen stiff.
tm.「この町の港から船で出て すぐ近くの洞くつに\n クレイモランを拠点に 活動して: "Sail from this town's port to a nearby cave: the Vikings who base themselves at Sniflheim have a hideout there.
